add_skill: add a marketplace skill by name to a destination directory with optional force overwrite
update_skills: update installed marketplace skills by re-syncing managed skill installs from the bucket
load_marketplace_skills: load marketplace skills from the Hugging Face skills bucket marketplace JSON payload
install_marketplace_skill: install a marketplace skill into a local directory with atomic replace on existing installs
apply_single_update: apply a single skill update check returning up_to_date, unmanaged, or source_unreachable status
